caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a lid on top. The chest is primarily light brown, with the wood grain clearly visible. The front panel of the chest features two large circular floral motifs, each encircled by an arch shape in dark brown. Each motif consists of a central flower with six petals and additional smaller floral and leafy decorations extending outward in shades of green, red, and yellow. Between the two circular motifs, there is a small area with handwritten yellowish inscriptions, including the letters "L W," the year "1798," and some additional text. Four vertically-oriented, dark brown spindle-shaped columns frame the two circular designs, two on each side. The sides of the chest have a series of heart- or teardrop-shaped blue designs arranged vertically along the edges. The base of the chest is solid, slightly wider than the main body, with bracket feet at each corner. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and a small signature is written in the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
